hardening.minimized_reason: Maintain the Team Edition release without the shell dependency of the Wolfi compatibility stream.
hardening.pledge_reason: No package-enforced pledge-style capability policy is claimed; service confinement is tracked in Werewolf forms.

changes.what: Mattermost Team Edition for werewolf's mattermost form: upstream's release for each arch, pinned by sha256, as Mattermost publishes it (its images are amd64 alone, Ubuntu's userland beside the server). The server is one static Go program; beside it the web app, translations, mail templates and fonts it finds from its own path. mmctl and the prepackaged plugins stay out: the form runs neither. 11.7 is Mattermost's extended support release, supported into 2027-05: its migrations run one way, so a rolled-back slot reads its data only within one release line. Wolfi's mattermost-11.7 stopped at 11.7.2 and brings bash.
changes.why: Maintain the Team Edition release without the shell dependency of the Wolfi compatibility stream.

wolfi.removal_condition: Wolfi provides equivalent packaging, supported versions, architectures and required hardening; review compatibility before retiring this context.
